newsitem.title: NORWAY: Testing begins on Azeri-Chirag oil pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Testing begins on Azeri-Chirag oil pipeline.

text.p: The crude pipeline which will carry oil from the early production phase on the offshore Azeri-Chirag field in the Caspian to the Black Sea is currently under test, one of the partners, Den norske stats oljeselskap AS, said on Thursday. Azerbaijan's state oil company, Socar, has begun to fill the line with oil from domestically producing fields, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Azeri-Chirag is scheduled to come on stream towards the end of 1997.
The northern route export pipeline runs from the Sangachal oil terminal south of Azeri capital Baku, through Chechnya to the Russian port of Novorossiisk.
Statoil has an 8.56 percent stake in the Azerbaijan International Operating Co (AIOC) consortium, which is operator of the field.
